page.overview:
Who is Gandoca?

Gandoca was a Costa Rican fisherman who was the cousin of Diego, although he identified him as 'Dieguito.'

Howard King brought Gandoca to meet Lewis Dodgson and George Baselton and he and King told the two he has a boat. He also identified Richard Levine when Dodgson showed him a picture and told Dodgson when Levine came. Gandoca was initially reluctant to sail to Isla Sorna due to the weather, however, when shown five thousand in unspecified currency he agreed to take the trio. Later, Sarah Harding boarded his fishing boat when Dodgson cunningly invited her to join them. Gandoca was most likely in the returning fishing boat which King spotted and it initially did not leave even with the incoming storm. However, King later spotted them leaving.
